CLIPLoader.name: CLIPLoader
CLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sd: clip-l
stable cascade: clip-g
sd3: t5 xxl / clip-g / clip-l
stable audio: t5 base
mochi: t5 xxl
cogvideox: t5 xxl (226-token padding)
cosmos: old t5 xxl
lumina2: gemma 2 2B
wan: umt5 xxl
hidream: llama-3.1 (Recommend) or t5
omnigen2: qwen vl 2.5 3B
joyimage: qwen3-vl 8B
lens: gpt-oss-20b
pixeldit: gemma 2 2B elm
minimax: MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL or Music3 Qwen/RVQ

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.
output_tooltips: The model used for denoising latents.
The CLIP model used for encoding text prompts.
The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images to and from latent space.

model.tooltip: The model to apply context windows to during sampling.

context_length.tooltip: The length of the context window.

context_overlap.tooltip: The overlap of the context window.

context_schedule.tooltip: Step-dependent scheduling algorithm for context windows.

context_stride.tooltip: The stride of the context window; only applicable to uniform schedules.

closed_loop.tooltip: Whether to close the context window loop; only applicable to looped schedules.

fuse_method.tooltip: The method to use to fuse the context windows.

dim.tooltip: The dimension to apply the context windows to.

freenoise.tooltip: Whether to apply FreeNoise noise shuffling, improves window blending.

cond_retain_index_list.tooltip: List of latent indices to retain in the conditioning tensors for each window. For concat-style I2V models (e.g. Wan I2V, HunyuanVideo I2V, Cosmos I2V, SVD) the encoded start image lives in the c_concat conditioning channels; setting this to '0' will retain that start image content at sub-pos 0 of every window.

split_conds_to_windows.tooltip: Whether to split multiple conditionings (created by ConditionCombine) to each window based on region index.

latent_retain_index_list.tooltip: List of latent indices to retain in the noise latent itself for each window. Use for workflows where reference content (e.g. a start image) lives directly in the noise latent rather than in separate conditioning channels (e.g. inplace-style I2V like LTXV, AnimateDiff). Independent of cond_retain_index_list.

causal_window_fix.tooltip: Whether to add a causal fix frame to non-0-indexed context windows.

output_tooltips: The model with context windows applied during sampling.
ContextWindowsManual.name: ContextWindowsManual

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

width.tooltip: The width of the latent images in pixels.

height.tooltip: The height of the latent images in pixels.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

EmptyLatentImage.name: EmptyLatentImage
EmptyLatentImage.description: Create a new batch of empty latent images to be denoised via sampling.
output_tooltips: The empty latent image batch.

EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio.name: EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio
EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio.description: Creates an empty MiniMax Music3 audio latent for the requested duration.

GetImageSize.name: GetImageSize
GetImageSize.description: Returns the width, height, and batch size of the image.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

GetVideoComponents.name: GetVideoComponents
GetVideoComponents.description: Extracts video frames, audio, frame rate, bit depth, and color space.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

KSampler.name: KSampler
KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.
output_tooltips: The denoised latent.

LTXAVTextEncoderLoader.name: LTXAVTextEncoderLoader
LTXAVTextEncoderLoader.description:
Recipes:
ltxav: gemma 3 12B or matching gemma 4 model

image.tooltip: Image or video to condition the latent video on. Must be 8*n + 1 frames. If the video is not 8*n + 1 frames, it will be cropped to the nearest 8*n + 1 frames.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to start the conditioning at. For single-frame images or videos with 1-8 frames, any frame_idx value is acceptable. For videos with 9+ frames, frame_idx must be divisible by 8, otherwise it will be rounded down to the nearest multiple of 8. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

attention_mask.tooltip: Optional pixel-space spatial mask. Controls per-region conditioning influence via self-attention, multiplied by strength.

iclora_parameters.tooltip: Optional IC-LoRA parameters from a Get IC-LoRA Parameters node. Used for adjusting guide processing as required by certain IC-LoRAs (eg. those with a reference_downscale_factor > 1). When chained, each LTXVAddGuide uses only the parameters connected to it.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.
The Audio VAE model to use for encoding.

LTXVConcatAVLatent.name: LTXVConcatAVLatent
LTXVConcatAVLatent.description: Merge a video latent and an audio latent into a joint AV latent (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

LTXVDualCFGGuider.name: LTXVDualCFGGuider
LTXVDualCFGGuider.description: Separate CFG scales for the video and audio modalities of a packed LTXV-AV latent.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

LTXVSeparateAVLatent.name: LTXVSeparateAVLatent
LTXVSeparateAVLatent.description: Split a joint AV latent into its video and audio latents (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.
output_tooltips: The modified diffusion model.
The modified CLIP model.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to anchor the image or the clip's first frame at. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE, needed when an image is connected.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE, needed when an audio is connected.

image.tooltip: Image or video frames to anchor. Multi-frame batches are anchored as a clip and cropped down to the model's valid clip lengths: 5, 22, 39... (17k + 5) frames. Batches shorter than 5 frames use only the first image.

audio.tooltip: Soundtrack to anchor starting at the same frame index, cropped to the video's remaining duration.

MiniMaxH3AddGuide.name: MiniMaxH3AddGuide
MiniMaxH3AddGuide.description: Anchor an image, a short clip, audio, or a clip with its soundtrack at any frame of a MiniMax H3 video. Chain several nodes to anchor several frames.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)
Frame count at 24 fps, (124 = ~5s, trained range is ~124-362)

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity. Reference tokens ride through every sampling step, so 'max' can be several times slower.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE. Without it reference images/videos only condition the text encoder.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE. Without it reference audio only conditions the text encoder.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.name: MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo
MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.description: <Picture i> / <Video k> / <Audio j> reference conditioning for MiniMax H3. Use the same tags when prompting.

max_duration.tooltip: Maximum duration in seconds; the model can end the song earlier.

MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode.name: MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode
MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode.description: Uses a MiniMax Music3 CLIP model to generate the acoustic conditioning sequence.

PreviewAny.name: PreviewAny
PreviewAny.description: Preview any input value as text.

device.tooltip: auto uses spare VRAM, then RAM. cpu (RAM) is prefetched behind compute and costs little speed. off recomputes the prefix every step, which is slower but is the one way to rule the cache out.

dtype.tooltip: Storage precision. default is lossless. int8 halves the cache at about bf16 accuracy, int4 quarters it but roughly doubles the per-step error.

QwenImage21Cache.name: QwenImage21Cache
QwenImage21Cache.description: Allows setting the KV cache device and quantization, by default the model uses the auto -option. Quantization potentially speeds up edit workflows when memory starved

ReferenceLatent.name: ReferenceLatent
ReferenceLatent.description: This node sets the guiding latent for an edit model. If the model supports it you can chain multiple to set multiple reference images.

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

ResizeImageMaskNode.description: Resize an image or mask using various scaling methods.

input_color_space.tooltip:
Colorspace of the input tensor. The EXR is always written as scene-linear in the matching gamut.
sRGB — input is sRGB-encoded Rec.709; the inverse sRGB EOTF is applied.
HDR — input is HLG-encoded Rec.2020 (BT.2100); the inverse HLG OETF is applied to get scene-linear light.
linear — input is already scene-linear (Rec.709 primaries); written through unchanged. Use this for renderer/compositor output.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit YUV420 for sRGB and 10-bit YUV420 for HDR.

SeedVR2Conditioning.name: SeedVR2Conditioning
SeedVR2Conditioning.description: Build SeedVR2 positive/negative conditioning from a VAE latent.

original_resized_images.tooltip: The original resized image before pre-processing, used as reference.

color_correction_method.tooltip: Method to match the generated image colors to the original image. lab: transfer color in CIELAB space, preserving detail (most faithful). wavelet: transfer low-frequency color, keeping upscaled high-frequency detail. adain: match per-channel mean/std (fastest, global tint). none: skip color transfer (geometry alignment only).

output_tooltips: The aligned, color-corrected image.
SeedVR2PostProcessing.name: SeedVR2PostProcessing
SeedVR2PostProcessing.description: Align the generated image with the original resized image and apply color correction.

SeedVR2Preprocess.description: Pad a resized image for SeedVR2 model. Alpha channel is dropped. The node Post-Process SeedVR2 Output re-applies it from the original resized image.

latent.tooltip: The VAE-encoded SeedVR2 latent to split.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Latent frames shared between adjacent chunks and crossfaded at merge; 0 = no overlap.

chunking_mode.tooltip: manual = use frames_per_chunk exactly; auto = predict the largest chunk that fits free VRAM.

SeedVR2TemporalChunk.name: SeedVR2TemporalChunk

SeedVR2TemporalMerge.name: SeedVR2TemporalMerge
SeedVR2TemporalMerge.description: Recombine sampled SeedVR2 latent temporal chunks into one latent, crossfading each overlap with a Hann window sized by the temporal_overlap wired from Split SeedVR2 Latent.

generate_audio_codes.tooltip: Enable the LLM that generates audio codes. This can be slow but will increase the quality of the generated audio. Turn this off if you are giving the model an audio reference.

resolution.tooltip: Reference images are resized to about resolution x resolution pixels, at multiples of 32, preserving aspect ratio. 0 keeps each reference at its own size, rounded to a multiple of 32.

strict_duration.tooltip: If True, when the specified duration is not possible, an error will be raised.

device.tooltip: Where to keep the cache. cpu (RAM) is the safe choice, the cache will not fit in VRAM alongside the model at typical sizes. gpu (VRAM) can be faster if it fits.

dtype.tooltip: Storage precision. default stores the activations in the model's compute dtype. int8 halves the cache, int4 quarters it, convrot is used to retain accuracy.

WanAnimate2Cache.name: WanAnimate2Cache
WanAnimate2Cache.description: Caches the pose-video's per-block activations so it runs once instead of on every sampling step. Roughly halves generation time Tradeoff is ~12.5 GB of system RAM at 480x832/81 frames in bf16 (scales with resolution and length). With context windows each window is cached separately, so RAM scales with the window count; use the static_standard schedule, as uniform schedules shift the windows every step and nothing ever recurs to hit the cache.

batch_size.tooltip: Number of videos to generate simultaneously.

video_frame_offset.tooltip: Frames to seek into the pose video. Connect to the video_frame_offset output of the previous node when extending.

pose_strength.tooltip: Scales the pose video's influence on the motion. 1.0 is the trained behavior; below weakens adherence, above amplifies. 0.0 mutes it but does not fully remove it.

pose_start_percent.tooltip: Sampling percent at which the pose influence starts. Outside the window the pose branch is skipped entirely, which also speeds those steps up.

pose_end_percent.tooltip: Sampling percent at which the pose influence ends. Motion is mostly established early, so e.g. 0.7 can loosen fine detail while keeping the choreography.

reference_image_strength.tooltip: Scales how strongly generated frames attend to the reference image's latent frame. Below 1.0 loosens identity/appearance adherence (e.g. to let the prompt restyle), above tightens it against drift.

pose_video.tooltip: The video whose motion is transferred to the reference character.

clip_vision_output.tooltip: CLIP vision of the reference image.

positive_pose.tooltip: Prompt for the pose-video branch, describing the motion rather than the character. Defaults to positive. Used for both the cond and uncond passes.

clip_vision_output_pose.tooltip: CLIP vision of the pose video's first frame. Defaults to clip_vision_output.

continue_motion.tooltip: Previous motion sequence to continue from for temporal consistency.
